title: Executive Snapshot Remediation Solutioning
objective: Ingest docs/EXECUTIVE_SNAPSHOT_2026-05-16.md and produce approval-ready remediation solutions for open issues while explicitly analyzing mutation class, approval requirements, sequencing, and no-bypass controls.
tasks: Ingest the May 16 executive snapshot as the current attention board.
Classify each open issue by priority, risk, dependency, mutation class, approval requirement, and safe next action.

Analyze whether proposed remediation requires no mutation, repo documentation mutation, repo code/IaC mutation, git mutation, runtime/security mutation, destructive cleanup, network/filesystem mutation, or external publication.
Produce solution options that can be approved individually by the operator.
Separate approval-ready actions from actions that require additional verification first.
Preserve fail-closed posture, governance inheritance, runtime truth alignment, and no-bypass execution.
Do not execute remediation, rotate secrets, modify runtime, clean Git internals, publish externally, or activate held governance standards.
rules: No tool grants or permission expansion.
Treat live runtime as authoritative unless refreshed evidence proves otherwise.
Any mutation must be returned as an approval request with scope, risk, evidence, rollback or containment posture, and verification plan.
